title: Normalized ordinary etale system compact-support projection data
statement: Let $c=(j,p_f)$ be a compactification of a scheme morphism $f:X\to Y$ [def-weil-compactifications-refinements]. For a prime $\ell$, a coefficient sequence is a functor $B:\mathbf N^{op}\to\operatorname{CommRing}$ with finite values killed by powers of $\ell$. On $W_{et}$ take the constant ring sheaves $B_n$, their actual transition maps, strict semilinear systems and their ordinary unbounded derived category [lem-coef-semilinear-derived-sections], [lem-pur-system-level-left-extension]. The normalized ordinary etale system projection data consist of the following presentations, simultaneously in $B$ and compatible ring-sequence maps $a:B\to C$. Geometric direct image is module-sheaf pushforward on the vertical sequence site along etale base change, with structural ring map carrying every constant generator to itself. Inverse image is its exact left adjoint. For the open factor take exact extension by zero left adjoint to that inverse image; set $F_B=Rp_{f,B,*}j_{!,B}$. Derived geometric adjunctions are obtained from these ordinary adjunctions and canonical right derivation. Scalar extension uses the actual normalized K-flat system scalar model [lem-pur-sheaf-ring-derived-coefficient-adjunction], [lem-pur-derived-change-of-rings]. Restriction commutes with ordinary geometric image by the identity on sections; its inverse-image and derived-image comparisons are the corresponding adjunction mates. The open comparison is the mate under the ordinary open adjunction. Their paste is $d_a:U_a^YF_C\cong F_BU_a^X$. Define $q_a:T_a^YF_B\to F_CT_a^X$ as the scalar mate of $d_a^{-1}$. Evaluation is actual level evaluation followed by restriction from the constant ring sheaf to the constant ring; its geometric, open and scalar comparisons are fixed by the same section identities and adjunction mates. The balanced scalar associator and identity comparison are those of normalized scalar models [lem-pur-system-scalar-coherence]. Define the successive projection path using these associators and $q_a,q_b$. For a single ring map, use the ordinary etale compact-support scalar projection and its proper/open restriction and composition words [lem-pur-etale-compact-scalar-coherence]. The data impose no projection invertibility or cocycle equation.
